description: This file defines a static class 'IncorrectProxyBaseClassSpecificationDiagnostic' that contains diagnostic rules and methods related to verifying proxy base class specifications within the Orleans code generator diagnostics.

classes.name: IncorrectProxyBaseClassSpecificationDiagnostic
classes.description: A static class providing diagnostic rules and creation methods for incorrect proxy base class specifications.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a Diagnostic object indicating an incorrect proxy base class, given the base class symbol, location, and a complaint message.
